title: Your prices. Your counter.
description: Find an item, check its price, and keep control of every line.
draftNotice: Draft bill · Lines stay on this device while the workspace is open. Sales records and payments are not enabled yet.
emptyBody: Search your catalog or choose a favourite to start.
error: We couldn’t update this price. Please try again.
priceHint: Price per {{unit}}, never the line total.
saved: Your price is saved for future additions.
conflict: A newer price was saved. Refresh before changing it again.
stale: Market estimate is over three days old.
low-confidence: Market confidence is too low; using the catalog fallback.
no-market: No regional estimate; using the catalog fallback.
feed-off: Market feed is off; using the catalog fallback.
invalid: Enter a valid non-negative price and a positive quantity.
newBody: The current lines will be cleared. Your saved prices stay in your account.
drift: Your saved price is over 14 days old and differs from the market estimate.
wholesale: Wholesale has risen since you saved this price. Review your rate.
margin: Your saved price is below your target margin.
futurePayments: Saved sales and payment collection are planned. This draft does not create a sale.
